WHERE crash_date >= DATE '\''2013-01-01'\'' AND crash_date < DATE '\''2026-01-01'\'' GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr",[p]).fetchall(); total=con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '\''2013-01-01'\'' AND crash_date < DATE '\''2026-01-01'\''",[p]).fetchone()[0]; null_dates=con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date IS NULL",[p]).fetchone()[0]; default_dates=con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date IN (DATE '\''0001-01-01'\'', DATE '\''1900-01-01'\'', DATE '\''1970-01-01'\'')",[p]).fetchone()[0]; null_outcome=con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE crash_date >= DATE '\''2013-01-01'\'' AND crash_date < DATE '\''2026-01-01'\'' AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL",[p]).fetchone()[0]; os.makedirs("out",exist_ok=True); facts=[("population_rows_2013_2025",total),("crash_date_missing_rows_filewide_pre_year_filter",null_dates),("crash_date_known_default_dates_filewide",default_dates),("number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_in_population",null_outcome)]; facts += [(f"population_rows_{yr}",n) for yr,n,_,_ in rows]; facts += [(f"year_{yr}_first_crash_date",str(first)) for yr,n,first,last in rows]; facts += [(f"year_{yr}_last_crash_date",str(last)) for yr,n,first,last in rows]; f=open("out/check_1.csv","w",newline=""); w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["fact","value"]); w.writerows(facts); f.close(); print("population_rows",total); print("year_rows",rows); print("crash_date_missing_filewide",null_dates,"default_dates_filewide",default_dates,"ped_killed_missing_in_population",null_outcome)'
